Text fields and list searches now take pastes: Ctrl+V (Cmd+V on macOS) inserts the clipboard. Line breaks and other control characters are dropped, and the text is cut at the field's maximum length.

Works on every target, from Forge 1.7.10 to 26.3.

```groovy
repositories { maven { url "https://repo.dreamys.studio/" } }
dependencies { implementation "studio.dreamys:icarus-<loader>-<minecraft version>:3.0.1" }
```
